model.path_stability: stable symlink directory to immutable HF cache blobs; snapshot directory was observed to disappear during concurrent runs

objective: Trustworthy SwiftLLM FP16/W4 substrate directional Table 5 rerun with genuine low-bit decode kernel; no MorphServe dynamic adaptation

protocol.dataset_mapping: trace row i maps to i-th answer-bearing record in concatenated public DuReader demo dev then train files
protocol.f1_definition: macro mean per-request character-overlap F1; official DuReader-style whitespace removal; best reference per request
protocol.generation: greedy argmax; exactly 512 SwiftLLM steps; no sampling or EOS stopping
protocol.iteration_note: v3 uses the corrected FP16/W4 substrate. It preserves the v2 prompt/reference mapping but uses the first 16 frozen requests and scales their v2 offsets by 3.0, selected from FP16-only calibration before W4 comparison.
protocol.prompt_construction: content prefix + truncated context + answer cue preserved at prompt end, deterministic hello padding before cue; every prompt re-tokenized to exactly 1024
protocol.quantization: uniform W4 NF4 bitsandbytes proxy for all W4 conditions; not AWQ
protocol.segment_selection: first request-timestamp-started half-open 72-second window with at least 100 rows; current interval [744286,744358) with 106 rows
protocol.substrate_parity_gate: same-checkpoint HF Transformers FP16 first-token/top-k/8-token greedy continuation match recorded in /tmp/morphserve-parity-after-rope-head.json before v3 runs
protocol.w4_decode_kernel: bitsandbytes.gemv_4bit on source-layout NF4 weights; no full-weight dequantization on one-token decode
protocol.w4_prefill_kernel: bitsandbytes.matmul_4bit prefill fallback; Transformers/bitsandbytes 0.49 internally dequantizes for multi-row calls and this limitation is reported, while one-token decode uses gemv_4bit

AutoAWQ.attempt: source import succeeded; no AWQ fused kernel package or selective SwiftLLM integration available

DuReader.language: Chinese official DuReader 2.0 public demo dev+train records, first 106 answer-bearing rows; paper English-translated subset unavailable
